blocks.text: Biodiversity ka lafz “biological diversity” se bana hai. Is ka matlab hai mukhtalif ecosystems mein maujood zindagi ki shaklon ki variety (rang-a-rangi), jis mein species, genes aur ecosystems teenon ki diversity shamil hai. Yeh jandaron ki kasrat aur farq (richness aur variability), aur un ke aapas ke aur apne mahol (environment) ke saath taalluqaat (interactions) ko zahir karti hai.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.text: Ecosystem ek zinda, harkat karta hua (dynamic) system hai jis mein jandar aur un ka physical mahol (paani, mitti, hawa, roshni wagaira) ek doosre par asar daalte hain. Is mein tamam biotic factors (zinda cheezein) aur abiotic factors (be-jaan cheezein) shamil hain.

blocks.title: Niche
blocks.text: Niche kisi jandar ya species ka ecosystem mein kirdar (role) ya kaam hai. Is mein us ka habitat (rehne ki jagah), doosre jandaron ke saath us ke taalluqaat (predation yani shikaar, competition yani muqabla, aur symbiosis yani saath reh kar faida), aur ecosystem mein energy ke bahao mein us ka kirdar shamil hai.
Biodiversity kin levels par jaanchi jati hai
Biodiversity ki jaanch (assessment) kai levels par hoti hai, aur har level zindagi ki complexity ke bare mein apni alag maloomat deta hai.

Species level: is level par kisi ilaqe mein maujood mukhtalif species ko pehchaan kar aur gin kar biodiversity jaanchi jati hai. Species diversity mein sirf species ki tadaad nahi, balke har species ke afraad ki nisbati tadaad (relative abundance) aur un ka phailao (distribution) bhi shamil hai.

Genetic level: is level par biodiversity ka matlab hai ek species ke tamam afraad mein maujood genetic maloomat ki variety. Yeh genetic diversity species ke adapt hone (dhalne) aur zinda rehne ke liye bohat zaroori hai, kyunke isi se species mahol ki tabdeeliyon aur mushkilon ka saamna kar paati hai.

Ecosystem level: is level par jaanch mein habitats ki poori range aati hai: jungle (forests) aur daldali ilaqe (wetlands) se le kar ghaas ke maidan (grasslands) aur registan (deserts) tak. Is mein yeh samajhna shamil hai ke mukhtalif ecosystems kaise kaam karte hain aur poore mahol ki sehat (ecological health) mein kya hissa daalte hain.

blocks.text: Biodiversity maloom karne mein random sampling ki ahmiyat

Random sampling (be-tarteeb namoona lena, yani namoone ki jagah ittefaq se chunna) ecological studies mein kisi ilaqe ki biodiversity jaanchne ka buniyadi tareeqa hai. Yeh tareeqa in wajuhat se zaroori hai:

items: Bias (taraf-daari) kam karta hai: study area ke har hisse ko sample mein aane ka barabar mauqa milta hai, is liye nateeja poore ilaqe ki biodiversity ko zyada sahi dikhata hai.

Qabil-e-bharosa andaze deta hai: jama kiya gaya data statistics se analyse kar ke species richness (species ki tadaad), abundance (afraad ki tadaad) aur distribution (phailao) ka andaza lagaya ja sakta hai.
Muqabla (comparison) asaan banata hai: data jama karne ke ek jaise (standardized) tareeqon se mukhtalif ilaqon ya habitats ka muqabla ho sakta hai.
Sample ko poore ilaqe jaisa banata hai: study area ke mukhtalif hisson ko cover kar ke random sampling yaqeeni banati hai ke sample poore ilaqe ki diversity ko zahir kare (representativeness).

Conservation (hifazat) mein madad deta hai: random sampling se sahi jaanch un ilaqon ki pehchaan ke liye zaroori hai jin ki hifazat sab se aham hai, aur waqt ke saath biodiversity ki tabdeeliyon par nazar rakhne ke liye bhi.

blocks.text: Biodiversity jaanchne ke tareeqe
Kisi ilaqe mein jandaron ke phailao (distribution) aur tadaad (abundance) ko jaanchne ke liye kai tareeqe istemal hote hain:
Phailao (distribution) jaanchne ke tareeqe
1. Quadrat sampling

Is mein study area ko ek grid (jaali) mein baanta jata hai aur be-tarteeb (random) chune hue chaukoron (quadrats) ke andar sample liya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par podon ki aabadi ya ek jagah jure rehne wale (sessile) jandaron ke liye mufeed hai. Misal: jungle mein researcher ek muqarrar size ke quadrats bichha kar har quadrat mein har plant species ki maujoodgi ya ghair maujoodgi likhta hai.
2. Transect sampling

Is mein study area ke aar paar ek line ya patti (transect) bichhai jati hai aur is line ke saath baqaida faaslon par species note ki jati hain. Yeh tareeqa badalte mahol mein species ka phailao dekhne ke liye achha hai. Misal: saahil (coastal zone) par high tide line se low tide line tak transect bichha kar intertidal (jowar bhaate ke darmiyan wale) jandaron ki qismein aur tadaad note ki ja sakti hai.
3. Aerial surveys

Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz (aircraft) ya drones se bare ilaqon mein jandaron ka phailao dekha aur note kiya jata hai. Misal: kisi bare wetland mein parindon ki species ka phailao dekhna, ya savanna (ghaas ke bare maidan) mein bare mammals ki aabadi par nazar rakhna.

Transect Sampling: ek kaarkun podon wale maidan ke aar paar bichhi line ke paas baith kar line ke saath chaukor quadrat frame rakhta hai. blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Quadrat sampling mein ilaqe ko grid (jaali) mein baant kar sirf be-tarteebi se chune gaye khanon mein jandar gine jate hain. Transect sampling mein ek line (transect) gradient ke aar paar bichhai jati hai, jaise sahil par high tide line se low tide line tak, aur line ke saath barabar faaslon par record kiya jata hai. Aerial surveys mein hawai jahaz ya drone oopar se bare ilaqe ki tasveerein le kar jandaron ka phailao dekhte hain, jaise parindon ke jhund ya savanna ke bare janwar.
Tadaad (abundance) jaanchne ke tareeqe

items: Point counts: ek muqarrar jagah se, muqarrar waqt tak, kisi species ke nazar aane wale afraad gin kar likhe jate hain. Yeh tareeqa aam taur par parindon aur harkat karne wale doosre janwaron ke liye hai.

Mark-recapture: kisi species ke afraad ko pakar kar, un par nishaan laga kar chhor diya jata hai; phir baad mein dobara pakar kar aabadi ka size aur density (ghanapan) ka andaza lagaya jata hai. Yeh un janwaron ke liye mufeed hai jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
Quadrat counts: researchers har quadrat ke andar kisi species ke afraad ginte hain aur in ginti se poori aabadi (overall abundance) ka andaza lagate hain.
Capture-recapture methods: yeh models aisi baaton (variables) ka hisaab rakhte hain jaise har dafa pakre jaane ka alag imkaan (probability) aur janwaron ka ek ilaqe se doosre mein jaana.
Remote sensing: satellite ya drone ki tasveeron se species ki tadaad aur phailao jaancha jata hai, khaas kar bohat bare ya aise ilaqon mein jahan pahunchna mushkil ho.

blocks.title: Tareeqa chunna
blocks.problem: Ek student jaanna chahta hai ke talaab ke kinare se khushk dhalaan tak poday kaise badalte hain, aur alag se yeh ke talaab mein kitne mendak hain. Kaun se tareeqe munasib hain?
steps: Podon ka sawal ek gradient (geela se khushk) ke aar paar phailao ke bare mein hai, is liye talaab ke kinare se dhalaan tak transect, jis par baqaida faaslon par quadrats ya records hon, sahih intikhab hai.
Mendak harkat karte aur chhupte hain, is liye unhein seedha ginna mushkil hai. Mark-recapture un ki aabadi ka andaza deta hai.
blocks.answer: Podon ke liye transect sampling; mendakon ke liye mark-recapture.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Biodiversity zindagi ki variety hai: species, genes aur ecosystems.
Ecosystem: jandar aur un ka physical mahol (biotic aur abiotic factors). Niche: ecosystem mein ek species ka kirdar.
Biodiversity species, genetic aur ecosystem levels par jaanchi jati hai.
Random sampling bias kam karti hai, qabil-e-bharosa andaze deti hai, muqabla mumkin banati hai, sample ko poore ilaqe jaisa banati hai aur conservation mein madad deti hai.
Distribution: quadrat sampling, transect sampling, aerial surveys. Abundance: point counts, mark-recapture, quadrat counts, capture-recapture methods, remote sensing.

blocks.prompt: Biodiversity jaanchne ke teen darje batayein, aur phailao ka ek tareeqa aur tadaad ka ek tareeqa batayein, is ke saath ke har ek kis qisam ke jandar ke liye munasib hai.
blocks.explanation: Species, genetic aur ecosystem darje. Distribution: quadrat sampling podon aur sessile jandaron ke liye munasib hai (ya gradient ke liye transects, bare ilaqon ke liye aerial surveys). Abundance: point counts parindon aur harkat karne wale janwaron ke liye; mark-recapture un janwaron ke liye jinhein seedha ginna mushkil ho.
